description: This file defines an interface named CategoryService, which declares methods for managing and retrieving category entities in an e-commerce system. The interface extends a generic sales manager service and includes methods for listing categories by various criteria, getting category descriptions, adding categories and descriptions, and counting products within categories.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Retrieves a list of categories based on store and lineage string, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves categories based on store and SEO URL, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Fetches the description of a specific category in a given language.

methods.name: addCategoryDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a category.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child category to a parent category.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists categories with the specified category as parent.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Lists categories within a store filtered by parent category.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves categories matching a name within a store and language.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories associated with a store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category based on store and category code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists categories within a store filtered by language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new category or updates an existing one.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories to a specific depth within a store.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories to a specific depth within a store, filtered by language.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Retrieves categories based on store code and lineage string.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category based on store code and category code.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Fetches a category by store and SEO URL.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists categories that are children of a given parent, filtered by language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a category description in a specific language by category ID.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Returns a list with product counts per category for a store.

methods.name: listByCodes
methods.description: Lists categories matching given codes within a store, filtered by language.

methods.name: listByIds
methods.description: Retrieves categories by their IDs within a store, filtered by language.
